description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for two text analysis methods, TEXTBLOB and VADER, when applied to different types of tweet data. The horizontal axis represents the tweet categories, labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet”, and is a categorical axis with no defined order. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For “Emoji Tweets”, TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar with diagonal stripes and reaches an approximate height of 0.4, while VADER is represented by a solid green bar reaching approximately 0.65. For “Overall Tweet”, TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar with diagonal stripes reaching approximately 0.45, and VADER is represented by a solid green bar reaching approximately 0.62. The bars are arranged in pairs, one for each method within each tweet category. A legend indicates that the white bars with diagonal stripes represent TEXTBLOB and the solid green bars represent VADER. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
